g.text: Revenue increased in Q3 2025, but gross margin fell. What caused it?
502,819 rows · 498,112 observations with a value · Q3 2025 by order_date · 6 verified, 0 withheld · 4 shown, ranked
Electronics accounts for 80.3% of the revenue increase — the largest single contribution across category.
Of the -7.63 point margin change, -3.96 comes from rate movement within categories and -3.67 from mix shifting between them.
Beauty is the exception: revenue fell 4.1% while its margin rose 2.2 points.
No breakdown was named in the question, so drivers were chosen by the planner. Ambiguity is recorded in the evidence.
but gross margin fell. What caused it?
